# Network-guide source fixtures

The 32 Markdown chapters are reusable inputs for `scripts/knowledge-book-bindings-demo.ts`, `scripts/knowledge-book-network-acceptance.ts` and `scripts/knowledge-book-large-acceptance.ts`. The scripts select the `app-`, `exp-`, `link-`, `net-`, `sec-` and `trans-` chapter files.

Keep source fixtures in this directory. Generated state, reports, screenshots and other execution output belong in the ignored `artifacts/` or `.local/` directories. Reviewed documentation evidence is archived under `docs/verification/`.
